welcome.title: Welcome to GP.A
welcome.description:
Hi! I'm GP.A, GreenPulse's AI assistant. I help SMEs assess their ESG readiness and green finance eligibility. Ask me about:
• Energy costs and reduction strategies
• ESG requirements for EU exports
• Green loan eligibility conditions

Let's start: what industry is your business in?
